description:
Did you know most people's first motorized bikes were Motobecanes? Now, After nearly a decade of intensive research and design on eBikes, Motobecane USA has developed and launched their first and best eBikes possible.

We believe more people riding bikes makes the world a better place and envision eBikes as an incredible opportunity to bring more people into cycling.

This is a Super Hybrid Adventure, Electric Mid-Drive Bike Professional Racing and Trail Proven Parts Imagine the pavement, neighborhoods and bike trails you will dominate with massive traction, fast rolling Adventure/29er Tires and a Rockshox RECON with 100mm up front. Test riders Compare the Elite eAdventure to top Front Suspension electric bikes. They say the Elite eAdventure has quite a bit of comfort and control. No corners are cut, the Elite eAdventure Shimano E5000/E6100 Electric MidDrive has top-rated specs. A Top Rated Rockshox RECON lockout fork with up to 100mm of travel. Rockshox are rated as some of the best, if not THE Best forks Period!

You won't be able to wipe the smile off your face 'cause this bike is so darn capable and super plush. With the Elite eAdventure series, you've got an incredibly capable front suspension mountain bike that'll do just about anything for Thousands less than any other bike.

Motobecane USA chose the Shimano STEPS mid-drive System for it's incredible power and performance and industry leading electric engine. Shimano has the best worldwide network of support. Virtually ever single bike related dealership has contact with Shimano for product support. When specs are compared, no other eBike beats the Elite eAdventure at this price. Stay tuned, we've got more models to come.
